scripts.validate: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.verify: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:css && npm run verify:server && npm run verify:client
scripts.verify:server: cd server && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.verify:client: cd client && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
